name: Graphs on 16 vertices with 65 edges whose triangles have small degree sums
description: construct() -> {'n': 16, 'edges': [[u, v], ...]}: a simple graph on 16 vertices with exactly 65 = floor(16^2/4) + 1 edges (so it has triangles). The score is the largest degree sum deg(u) + deg(v) + deg(w) over its triangles. Minimize. Scores below 24 would beat the published construction at n = 16; the conjectured asymptotic value is about 1.464n = 23.4.

sources.locator: Genghua Fan, Degree sum for a triangle in a graph (1988). Crossref record inspected; Erdős Problem #1033 page inspected (Bollobás-Erdős conjecture h(n) >= (2(sqrt 3 - 1) - o(1))n; known 21n/16 <= h(n) <= 2(sqrt 3 - 1)n + O(1) with the construction of Erdős and Laskar made explicit by Fan). Evaluated locally, that construction gives 24 for n = 16 (K_{10,6} plus a perfect matching on the 10-side); no finite optimum is documented. Scores below 24 would beat the published construction at n = 16; the conjectured asymptotic value is about 1.464n = 23.4.
